model_scope: 40-cell Gong/Guo graphite stack; 23 degC ambient; fixed 60 percent PWM; 4 A current ramp; measured current and voltage inputs

comsol_implementation.comparison_mesh: 40 x 3 x 5 surface nodes plus matched core nodes (1200 states)
comsol_implementation.delivered_python_mesh: 40 x 6 x 10 surface nodes plus matched core nodes (4800 states)
comsol_implementation.purpose: independent solver implementation of the frozen energy-conserving equations

interpretation_rule: A COMSOL consistency pass verifies implementation, not the two failed V13 experimental thresholds. The deliverable may be described only as an experimentally constrained high-resolution reference within the stated fixed-PWM scope, not as a validated variable-duty control plant.
